notes: Napoleon documentary, chapter 7 (Waterloo, Saint Helena and Legacy): 10 paintings x 4 seeds, 16:9, style ghm_painterly_v2. Client picks; nothing is final before approval.

shots.framing: wide interior of a grand palace hall, diplomats in court dress around a long table covered with maps and papers
shots.scene: the Congress of Vienna, March 1815, statesmen of Austria, Britain, Prussia and Russia receiving the news of Napoleon's return, chandeliers and tall windows
shots.lighting: cold daylight from tall windows mixed with chandelier light

shots.framing: wide shot from the crest looking down the slope, bearskinned columns of the Imperial Guard emerging from smoke and climbing toward the camera
shots.scene: the attack of the Imperial Guard at Waterloo, evening of 18 June 1815, trampled rye, dead horses, drifting smoke
shots.lighting: low golden evening sun behind the Guard, smoke glowing
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: wide shot along a line of British Foot Guards in red coats rising from the rye and firing a volley to the left, officers with swords
shots.scene: the British Foot Guards at Waterloo rising to fire at close range, 18 June 1815, Dutch-Belgian troops further along, smoke and flame from the muskets
shots.lighting: evening sun from the left, muzzle flashes
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: very wide shot of a valley at sunset, French troops streaming back in disorder, the Old Guard holding in squares, Prussian cavalry arriving from the right
shots.scene: the end of the Battle of Waterloo, evening 18 June 1815, abandoned guns, the inn of La Belle Alliance, burning farms
shots.lighting: red sunset through smoke, deep shadows

shots.framing: wide quiet landscape at dusk, the battlefield after the fighting, a broken gun carriage and a riderless horse in the foreground, distant figures with lanterns
shots.scene: the field of Waterloo on the night of 18 June 1815, trampled fields, smoke lying low, restraint, no visible wounds
shots.lighting: blue dusk, lantern glows, low mist
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: wide seascape, a British 74-gun ship of the line at anchor in a broad roadstead, a small boat rowing out toward it from the left
shots.scene: HMS Bellerophon off Rochefort, July 1815, Napoleon's boat approaching to surrender to Captain Maitland, the Ile d'Aix coast
shots.lighting: calm grey summer morning, silver sea

shots.framing: medium interior shot, the heavier ageing Napoleon in a white dressing gown seated in an armchair on the left, a secretary writing at a small table on the right
shots.scene: Longwood House, Saint Helena, about 1816, Napoleon dictating his memoirs to Las Cases, books, a billiard table, damp walls
shots.lighting: warm candlelight, rain on the window

shots.framing: wide landscape, dark volcanic cliffs dropping into the Atlantic on the right, a small house on a green plateau under low clouds on the left
shots.scene: Saint Helena, South Atlantic, Longwood plateau and the cliffs, sea birds, Atlantic swell
shots.lighting: moody dusk, shafts of light through low clouds, violet and ocean blue

shots.framing: wide interior view looking down into a circular crypt with a great red porphyry sarcophagus, under a golden dome
shots.scene: the tomb of Napoleon under the dome of Les Invalides, Paris, marble columns and statues, gilded light from the dome above
shots.lighting: golden light falling from the dome, cool marble shadows

shots.framing: still-life close-up on a desk, an open leather-bound volume of the Code civil des Francais, a quill and inkwell, a folded map of Europe and a sealed letter
shots.scene: the Civil Code of 1804 on a lawyer's desk in the nineteenth century, candle, books in the background
shots.lighting: warm candlelight, soft depth of field
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, readable text, letters, words, modern objects
